observed_schema_only: 940 frames; XYZ strings at l_hip/l_knee/l_ankle; recorded angle numeric; frame ID numeric; no timestamp field
coordinate_parser: Strict finite ASCII decimal/scientific number strings with optional surrounding whitespace; preserve raw file and record every supplied frame
comparison: Compute all three 3D triangle angles in original hip/knee/ankle order and as-is absolute differences from the recorded degree angle. Report all vertices, no best-vertex, complement, fit, range tuning, calibration or quality decision. Agreement is a circular arithmetic conformance check, not independent model accuracy.
prefix_rule: Retain every supplied frame. Never discard another first-five prefix; no invented IDs, interpolation or inferred milliseconds.
snapshots: First, middle ordinal len//2, last original supplied frame; original three-point coordinates only, no RGB/MP33 reconstruction
zero_rule: Zero components and a point at origin are not fabricated or silently removed; coincident points/missing fields do not produce angles; no tracking-confidence inference
other_subjects: Only metadata roster projected during syntax streaming; no other trajectory objects or outcomes
